latest.title: Prehospital TXA lowers mortality in bleeding trauma
latest.finding: Lower 28–30-day mortality with prehospital TXA (RR 0.81, 95% CI 0.68–0.95); TBI mortality (RR 0.87, 95% CI 0.64–1.20) and in-hospital mortality came from single trials; no statistically significant increase in thromboembolic events or seizures.

latest.title: First responder alerts linked to more defibrillation
latest.finding: Activation (41% of cases) predicted bystander defibrillation of 9.6% vs 5.5% at 389 m and 13.0% vs 4.8% at 1,183 m; TMLE estimated +6.1 pp bystander defibrillation (95% CI 4.5–7.8) and +1.8 pp 30-day survival (95% CI 0.1–3.6).

latest.title: Mobile app lifts simulated trauma performance
latest.finding: 35.4% of app-supported scenarios met all critical actions vs 6.3% without (adjusted OR 8.28, 95% CI 2.21–31.09); paediatric completion 30.4% vs 0%; users rated the app practical and valuable.
